# Shared React API Client (`@workspace/api-client-react`)

This library provides React Query hooks and types for communicating with the central API server. The client is auto-generated by [Orval](https://orval.dev/) from the OpenAPI schema contract defined in `@workspace/api-spec`.

---

## 📦 Features

* **Auto-generated Queries & Mutations**: Provides hooks (e.g. `useHealthCheck`, `useSync`) utilizing `@tanstack/react-query`.
* **Configurable Fetcher**: Contains a custom fetch utility (`custom-fetch.ts`) supporting:
  * Dynamic baseURL mapping (via `setBaseUrl`).
  * Dynamic Authentication header injection (via `setAuthTokenGetter`).

---

## 🚀 Usage

Configure the API client at your application's entrypoint:

```typescript
import { setBaseUrl, setAuthTokenGetter } from "@workspace/api-client-react";

// Set backend API address
setBaseUrl("https://api.nhai-attendance.gov.in/api");

// Provide custom token provider
setAuthTokenGetter(async () => {
  return "my-session-token-or-api-key";
});
```

Then, use the generated query/mutation hooks inside your React/React Native components:

```typescript
import { useHealthCheck } from "@workspace/api-client-react";

function HealthIndicator() {
  const { data, isLoading } = useHealthCheck();

  if (isLoading) return <Text>Checking...</Text>;
  return <Text>Status: {data?.status}</Text>;
}
```

---

## 🛠️ Rebuilding the Client

The client is regenerated whenever the OpenAPI contract changes. Run this command from the monorepo root:

```bash
pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec build
```
This runs the Orval code generator, updating the generated files in `@workspace/api-client-react/src/generated`.
